verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an open-source framework installable locally via pip/uv (crewai CLI), meaning the core product (agents, crews, tasks, flows, memory, tools) runs entirely self-hosted without requiring the CrewAI AMP/Enterprise cloud offering. Enterprise-only features (managed deployment, Crew Studio, REST API) are explicitly separate paid/hosted add-ons, confirming the core is self-hostable OSS. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of a full local self-hosted deployment (e.g., Docker/on-prem guide) and no explicit statement distinguishing 'core' vs cloud-only capabilities beyond docs claims.
